Who has the advantage right now?

Months of supply & slowing pace point the needle

Balanced · leaning buyer

For four years sellers called the shots. Not anymore. With roughly 4–6 months of inventory (six is "balanced") and homes taking longer to sell than a year ago, buyers finally have room to negotiate — and price reductions are common.

If you're buying

Ask for concessions, inspections, and time. You have it.

If you're selling

Price it right on day one — sharp pricing still wins fast offers.

Local spotlight

Good news on Florida insurance — it's finally stabilizing

The biggest worry I hear from out-of-state buyers is home insurance. Here's the encouraging 2026 update: Citizens, the state insurer, approved its first rate cut in years (−8.7%) this spring, and roughly 17 new carriers have entered Florida — meaning real competition and more options when you shop.

🌊 Coastal buyer tip

Near the water, you'll often need a separate flood policy on top of homeowners. Always check the property's FEMA flood zone before you make an offer — it can change your monthly cost meaningfully. I'll help you pull it.
